fact: Revenue Services Lesotho offers an online Individual Taxpayer Registration Form on its eServices site, which individuals fill in and attach documents to.
Minister Nthati Moorosi says the government is close to launching an integrated online services platform with an electronic payment gateway, 'almost done'.

UNDP and Lesotho's communications ministry launched the E-Service Outlet Model, in which internet and print shops and mobile money agents help people reach government e-service platforms, such as registering a business or obtaining a trader's licence, without visiting offices.

The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation held a validation exercise with ministries including Home Affairs, Public Service, Public Works and Finance on the first stage of automating e-services, with back-end integration to follow, per the Lesotho News Agency.
